purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically revises one self-owned Activity Schedule from an exact current placement MaterialStateRef, retains prior history, moves explicit currentness to one new floating-local placement state, and provides immutable idempotent replay without generic runtime Schedule DML.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, previous_material_state_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, starts_local_at timestamp without time zone, ends_local_at timestamp without time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates one immutable floating-local schedule.placement MaterialState per accepted non-replay revision.
state_history.current_binding: Locks the Schedule, requires the exact expected MaterialStateRef, closes the old open history episode, moves scoped currentness and opens one new episode.
state_history.chronology: The prior and new current-history episodes meet at one authoritative recorded_at instant.
state_history.immutability_policy: Replay returns the recorded old/new basis and payload; different intent or stale expected state cannot overwrite it.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Routine removal is migration-only and downgrade fails closed after revision receipts exist.

obligations: function is dante_owner SECURITY DEFINER with trusted search_path
runtime has EXECUTE only and no direct receipt/current/history DML
only an Activity Schedule belonging to the authenticated self scope is admitted
stale exact expected state conflicts before any new MaterialState is created
old history, new state, current binding, new history and receipt commit atomically
same operation and intent replay without rewriting currentness
